description: Heat Map Data - Table is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. This data is the raw data that drives our Heat Map process on our Portal. For use we recommend seeing the Heat Map Data - Substation Areas as this ties the data to a shapefile covering our EHV network Related Feature Pages Embedded Capacity Register Page - Our Embedded Capacity Register provides information on generation ... Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Net Zero Future, Connecting Demand, Connecting Generation. Its keywords are Extra High Voltage (EHV), High Voltage (HV), Connections, Generation, Demand, Network Capacity and Utilisation. The portal shows 2026-07-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
